items.prompt: "I had finished by then," she said. → She said she ___ finished by then.
items.explanation: Past perfect stays past perfect — no further backshift is needed.

items.prompt: She ___ taking full responsibility for the error.
items.explanation: 'Admit + gerund' is the precise reporting verb for this meaning.

items.prompt: He said the sun ___ in the east.
items.explanation: Universal truths stay in the present even in reported speech.

items.prompt: Complete with one word: She ___ me to check the figures twice.
items.explanation: 'Remind + object + to-infinitive' reports the instruction precisely.

items.prompt: Report the sentence keeping the universal truth: "Water boils at 100°C," the teacher said.
answers: The teacher said that water boils at 100°C
The teacher said water boils at 100°C

items.prompt: Report using 'admit': "I made a mistake," she said.
answers: She admitted that she had made a mistake
